title: AssistantDeltaPayload

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

itemId.description: The open item the fragments extend; its assistant.text or assistant.thinking closes it.

kind.description: What a fragment extends: the open item's text, or its thinking.

items.description: One fragment of text or thinking.

description: assistant.delta: a batch of fragments for the open item, flushed every 100 ms or 512 bytes; the snapshot holds settled items only, and a client applies deltas to the open item.
